name: ryu.sample-widget
description: Reference third-party MCP widget plugin. A tiny local Node MCP server (server.mjs) exposes one render tool (sample_widget.render) that returns structured data AND serves a self-contained skybridge HTML resource (ui://widget/sample.html). The approved mcp:server grant lets a Community plugin register the server; contributes.widgets plus widget:render authorize promotion into an inline chat widget. Copy this directory as the starting point for your own widget plugin.

sample_widget.description: Sample widget MCP server: one render tool + the ui://widget/sample.html resource.
